shared_elements: carved relief motifs on a rock surface
curvilinear/rounded forms suggesting a head or face
justification: A shows a highly conventional composition of two seated human figures in profile facing each other across an offering table, topped by symbols and with horizontal registers of script below, whereas B shows isolated boulders bearing shallow curvilinear carvings dominated by a spiral/volute and vague massed forms with no legible figural scene, registers or text. The only overlap is the generic fact of low-relief carved motifs including rounded head-like shapes, which any tradition could produce independently.
